title: MissedReadingService class not kick startet without new BG value
body:
Problem is, as long as there is not at least on BG value received, this class will be not started.
Expected behaviour: class is started right at the beginning

comments.body: This should be fixed in Mar 19th nightly by this commit: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/7d6718dddfcc8ca61c6892936b95b67aa1b72f73
